_comment:
'Action - {r}{r}, destroy Blade Cuff: Your daggers gain +1{p} this turn. Go again'

Printed BladeBreak and GoAgain come from the card DB keywords field (verified: blade_cuff keywords = ['BladeBreak', 'GoAgain']) - deliberately NOT authored. The DB GoAgain is inert for equipment: the engine consumes printed go again only for 'card' stack layers on resolution (engine.py:2407) and the meld path (engine.py:2309), never for activated layers, so there is no double-grant with the action point granted below.

activation_cost: 2 is card-level and DSL-authoritative for the {r}{r}; per DSL_REFERENCE it is NOT also modelled as a PAY_RESOURCES cost. Verified the cost pipeline reads only CARD-level activation_cost (loader.py:153, play.py:1522) - an ability-level copy would land in unread ab_params.

'Destroy Blade Cuff' is the ability cost, not an effect (a cost can block the play): DESTROY_SELF per the shipped dyn/blacktek_whisperers.json precedent. play._apply_activate pays costs before dispatching ON_ACTIVATE, and the effects still resolve against the destroyed card object (controller id preserved), which is exactly how Blacktek Whisperers works.

'Your daggers gain +1{p} this turn' is MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN scope TURN player SELF filtered to Dagger-subtype attacks; verified the handler reads amount/mod/scope/player/filter (effect_types.py:2149-2175), that the hook lands on the controller's turn_attack_hooks and is re-applied to every matching attack that turn (engine.py:1243-1259), and that daggers carry 'Dagger' in subtypes in the card DB (weapons attack as themselves, so combat.attack_card is the dagger).

DEVIATION FROM TRIAGE, flagged: triage named primitive 'GO_AGAIN', but both spellings of that idea are combat-scoped - the GO_AGAIN effect grants state.combat.keywords (effect_types.py:4854-4861) and GAIN keyword does the same (effect_types.py:4846-4852) - and this activation resolves OUTSIDE combat, where state.combat is None, so either would silently do nothing (shock_frock's GAIN-keyword go again has this same latent gap). Authored instead as GAIN asset ACTION_POINTS amount 1, which routes through effect_keywords.gain (effect_types.py:4816-4819) and grants the action point that go again means (CR 8.3.5). Minor approximation: CR 8.5.7b restricts go-again AP to the turn player; GAIN ACTION_POINTS does not check, but ACTIVATE timing confines activation to your own action phase, so controller == active player in every reachable state.
